note: THE ONE REGISTER. Read by the panel (Testing ②, fetched like rules.json) and by tools/nightly/run.py. A hypothesis is added with the date it was written and is never edited after; it is READ ONCE at minN on sessions from `from` onward. Registered NULLS are deliberate: a register that only holds hopes is a machine for producing wins.

hypotheses.claim: grade A holds LESS often than the base rate
hypotheses.refuteIf: held >= 50% or the CI covers the base
hypotheses.note: exploratory 32% on n=34 — the INVERSE of the grade's purpose. Known confound: A may be assigned in strong trends. If it survives, test the confound BEFORE touching the grade.

hypotheses.claim: a node's 2nd test holds MORE often than its 1st
hypotheses.note: exploratory 73% on n=22 vs 47% first tests.
exploratory +γ 52.2% / −γ 52.1%. Registered as a null ON PURPOSE.

hypotheses.claim: NULL — the rejection wick does not discriminate
hypotheses.note: measured 49.1% confirmed vs 48.6% weak on 970 rows. While this stands the wick is REPORTED, never WEIGHTED.

hypotheses.claim: a top-5 gamma node moves the HOD/LOD cell
hypotheses.predict: cell-rate shift >= 8 points in either direction
hypotheses.refuteIf: shift < 8 points or its CI covers the unconditioned cell
hypotheses.note: THE question the panel exists for. Baseline HLTAB AUC 0.879. Definition FIXED IN ADVANCE: within DEFL_NEAR (1.0 ATR) of a top-5-by-dollars node, wick-triggered. Needs the EVENT-level ledger (the defl store).

hypotheses.claim: an ON/PD sweep-reclaim that lands in a top-5 node band or at the King prints the extreme more often
hypotheses.predict: printed > 40% (base 24%, n=453 ON/PD sweep-reclaims over 284 sessions)
hypotheses.note: drafted from roadmap/FINDINGS-sweeps-first-read.md. The level's NAME was measured to add nothing (ON, PD, PDC, POC/VAH/VAL, PM, PW, IB, OR all within chance of a bounce off any fresh low); the node is the untested clause and the reason the tapereader exists. Needs the TAP record (v15.56) or the API backfill.

hypotheses.claim: a first-30-minute ON/PD sweep-reclaim prints the extreme more often than a bounce off any fresh low
hypotheses.refuteIf: printed <= 18% or the CI covers the fresh-low control
hypotheses.note: found at 27% (n=180) vs an 18% control on sessions BEFORE 2026-08-22 (tools/study-sweeps.py). Read again ONLY on sessions after it, by the nightly, with the same definitions.
